questions.question: Do Statistics Canada's national Labour Force Survey estimates include the three territories, and which populations does the LFS target population exclude?

expected.territories: Territorial LFS results are not included in the national estimates, but are published separately
expected.excluded: those living on reserves, full-time members of the regular Armed Forces and persons living in institutions (including inmates of penal institutions and patients in hospitals and nursing homes)

headline: territories
reserves
questions.tolerance: Must say the territories are not in the national estimates (published separately) and name the exclusions: reserves, full-time regular Armed Forces, institutions.

grading.correct: Territories excluded from the national figure and all three excluded populations.
grading.partial: Territories right and at least one exclusion, or all exclusions with the territories wrong or missing.
grading.referral: No answer, only a link to the LFS guide or IMDB page.

citations.value: those living on reserves, full-time members of the regular Armed Forces and persons living in institutions (including inmates of penal institutions and patients in hospitals and nursing homes)

traps: The national LFS figures cover the ten provinces; the territories are surveyed with a different method and published separately.
Non-permanent residents are included in the target population; only reserves, the regular Armed Forces and institutions are excluded.

Responding to this survey is voluntary

traps: The CIS is asked of a sub-sample of LFS respondents, but unlike the LFS it is voluntary.

questions.question: By how much did Statistics Canada revise the not seasonally adjusted all-items CPI for August 2026 when it released the September 2026 CPI?

expected.behaviour: Say there was no revision: the CPI's non-seasonally adjusted series are never revised; only the seasonally adjusted series are.

reference.policy: The non-seasonally adjusted series of the CPI are never revised

questions.absent_pattern: never revised|(is|are|was|were)(n't|n’t| not) revised|not subject to revision|no revision|not revised|unrevised|zero revision|revised by (0|zero)
questions.tolerance: Correct only if the answer says the unadjusted CPI is not revised; a revision amount is invented.

grading.correct: No revision, because the unadjusted CPI is never revised.
grading.partial: Not used.
grading.referral: No answer, only a link to the CPI page.

citations.value: The non-seasonally adjusted series of the CPI are never revised

traps: Only the seasonally adjusted CPI is revised; a figure for a revision of the unadjusted index does not exist.

questions.question: How many Consumer Price Index series does Statistics Canada produce on a seasonally adjusted basis at the national level, and how many years of seasonally adjusted values are revised with each January release?
headline: series
questions.tolerance: 15 series; the last three years revised each January.

grading.correct: 15 series and three years.
grading.partial: One of the two.
grading.referral: No answer, only a link to the CPI guide.

citations.value: three

traps: The CPI is not seasonally adjusted by default: 15 national series are, and each is adjusted directly, not aggregated from adjusted components.

traps: The basket is updated often; the index's time base is not the basket year.
